name: Open WebUI Terminals
desc: Sandboxed computers that give each Open WebUI chat its own machine.
desc_zh: 给每个 Open WebUI 对话各配一台沙箱电脑。
solves: A model that can only talk cannot finish real work; each chat gets a shell, files and a network to act in.
solves_zh: 只能说话的模型干不完真实的活；每个对话都有自己的 shell、文件和网络去执行。
best_for: You want the assistant to run a command and show you the result beside the chat.
best_for_zh: 你想让助手跑一条命令，并把结果显示在对话旁边。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — openwebui.com/blog）。 Blog post dated November 18, 2026 (JSON-LD datePublished 2026-11-18T03:55:39.000Z). Shipped inside Open WebUI v0.13.x but marketed under its own name and product page, so surface is in-product. 首次公开日期来源：https://openwebui.com/blog/introducing-terminals
